tasks.short: Assign work schedules for timely service

steps.what: Confirm service requirements, staff availability and scheduling constraints
Construct work schedules and resolve coverage and rest conflicts
Review service coverage, approve assignments and publish the work schedule

tasks.design: Configure deterministic coverage, skills, availability and rest constraints in {HCM}. The supervisor verifies inputs, resolves infeasible combinations and approves the exact schedule before publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: A spreadsheet requires repeated conflict and coverage comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shift schedulers support availability and conflict checks without a model allocating work from personal traits.
tasks.still_hard: A formally valid roster may not meet actual service needs or fair treatment expectations.
tasks.human_edge: Balance coverage and worker circumstances and explain difficult assignments.
tasks.altitude: Less roster construction; staffing and publication authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain suitable coverage and working-time constraints

evidence.claim: Shiftbase provides availability, open shifts, swaps, conflict warnings and automatic scheduling.
The proposed deterministic constraints and savings are E1 assumptions, not measured recreation-sector results.

assumptions: Boundary is this supervisor's roster input verification, construction and publication, excluding workers' service delivery and people-team contract maintenance.

The supervisor produces event coverage, required skills, checked availability and absence exceptions in s1, retaining all 30 hours for collection and capture. Existing staff availability messages remain unchanged; no new employee self-service duty is assumed.

The people team supplies approved contract hours and applicable rest rules through existing workforce records. Additional constraint maintenance is counted below; unknown rules or unavailable skills stop automatic construction for manual planning in s2.
Test native scheduler constraints before custom code. Existing scheduling runtime earns no labour saving; consultation and access depend on the local workforce arrangements.
unknowns: Applicable national and collective working-time rules
Availability quality and current roster effort
research_questions: Does a parallel roster trial reduce construction time without increasing capture, exceptions or assignment complaints?

already_counted.description: Input capture, schedule exception review and publication approval

incremental.description: Maintain coverage settings and review recurring scheduling exceptions
Maintain approved workforce constraints and access

approvals.approved_version: Exact staff, shifts, roles, coverage and reviewed exceptions in the published roster; changes require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+13.5+25=68.5; gross 31.5%, minus five focal upkeep gives 26.5% central net. Low assumes ten construction hours removable because many constraints need manual resolution.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train workers in procedures and policies

steps.what: Train workers in operational procedures and explain company policies

tasks.design: Keep practical worker training and policy explanation with the supervisor. Approved guidance in {DOCS} supports the interaction without a new content-generation or automated coaching task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Workers need demonstration, questions and feedback in the actual service environment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved materials already support the retained training.
tasks.still_hard: Repeating a policy does not establish that a worker can apply it safely.
tasks.human_edge: Notice misunderstanding and give practical feedback suited to the worker.
tasks.altitude: Training responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Procedure versions and practical competence expectations

evidence.claim: Direct worker training and policy explanation retain all labour in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is direct training, demonstration and questions, excluding separate learning-material production and formal certification records.
No new structured competence flag or automated worker assessment is introduced.
Existing native procedure access suffices. No deployment or additional maintenance is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current training responsibilities and procedure versions
research_questions: Can workers demonstrate the procedure rather than simply repeat its instructions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Practical training and clarification remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give customers event and activity information

steps.what: Clarify the customer's question about events or activities
Find current event dates, availability and published participation details
Furnish customers with relevant information and clarify any limitations

tasks.design: Configure one current event view in {CMS} using published {CALENDAR} and booking fields. Staff use fixed filters and source details to answer customers, retaining the conversation and escalating anything unconfirmed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event details are spread across calendars, web pages and booking screens.
tasks.enabler_now: A native consolidated view can reduce navigation without generating an answer.
tasks.still_hard: Cancelled events, limited places and accessibility questions need current verified information.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the customer's practical needs and explain uncertainty clearly.
tasks.altitude: Less lookup navigation; customer advice and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Event status, capacity and access-detail ownership

evidence.claim: A consolidated event lookup with fixed filters is an E1 design; no unsupported chatbot or measured customer-service saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's customer clarification, lookup and answer, excluding event planning and customer booking work.

The event coordinator's existing publication process produces event ID, title, dates, location, participation rules, booking link, status and verified access details. The booking system produces current capacity from existing sales; no new free sold-out flag is assumed.

The supervisor captures the request in s1 and checks source freshness within 18 retained s2 hours. Missing status, stale capacity or unknown access details returns to manual coordinator enquiry there; never infer availability.
Test native event views before custom integration. Additional coordinator checks and mapping maintenance are counted as other-role upkeep.
unknowns: Event record freshness and native view support
Current lookup burden and availability access
research_questions: Can one view reduce navigation while preserving source freshness and uncertain-request handling?

already_counted.description: Request clarification, source verification and customer explanation

incremental.description: Check stale views and report event-data faults
Maintain event fields, status checks and view mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+18+30=73; gross 27%, minus four focal upkeep gives 23% central net. Low assumes eight lookup hours removable when records remain dispersed or stale; all customer conversation remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on event programmes and activity schedules

steps.what: Review event ideas, service constraints and participant needs
Collaborate with staff to develop event programmes and activity schedules

tasks.design: Keep programme review and collaborative event choices with the supervisor and staff using {DOCS}. Publishing event records and constructing worker rosters remain separate tasks.
tasks.previous_blocker: A useful programme must reconcile participant interests, staff expertise and physical resources.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing proposals already support the retained collaboration.
tasks.still_hard: Popular ideas may conflict with staffing, space or service priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Build agreement around activities the team can deliver well.
tasks.altitude: Programme collaboration duties and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Translate agreed programme choices into delivery plans

evidence.claim: Collaborative programme judgement retains its labour; no separate document-production baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's idea review and programme discussion, excluding event-data publication, roster construction and implementation by other staff.
No automated programme choice or new structured preference capture is introduced.
Existing native document access is sufficient. No deployment or new maintenance is added, justifying zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Programme decision responsibilities and resource constraints
research_questions: Which activity choices depend on staff knowledge absent from written proposals?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Review and collaboration remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce roster construction and event lookup while retaining training, programme choices and customer conversations.
reach: Improve reliable coverage and event inputs with workforce and event coordinators
role.ambitious_version: A recreation supervisor with more attention available for staff and live service conditions.
